subject: Lab benchmark requests + MAP cost checks
messages:
From: Emily Rogers <emily@novafit.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: can you validate our units/$ assumptions?

Olga —

Quick reach out from Novafit (we're in the middle of the MAP with Redwood). Our finance team and procurement are pushing for a tighter unit-economics summary ahead of the exec review next week. Two asks: 

1) Can Redwood validate our tokens-per-dollar assumptions (we used 1.2M tokens / $1k for the pilot) and call out where caching/prefix reuse would materially change that?
2) We want a short lab benchmark plan (batching/prefetch scenarios + expected variance) so we can include it in the MAP and the evaluation plan.

Our internal deadline for the MAP close is 2025-05-30; ideally we get a short write-up + sample bench results before EOD 2025-05-22 so I can push to procurement.

Attachments: [initial-usage-patterns.csv (CSV)]

Would you be able to coordinate with ops to run a small prefetch + microbatch sweep and give a quick tokens/$ sensitivity table?

Thanks —
Emily Rogers
CFO, Novafit
emily@novafit.com

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, david.kim@redwood.com
Cc: emily@novafit.com
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: can you validate our units/$ assumptions?

Team — looping you in to scope the bench and a short MAP addendum for Novafit (see Emily's note below). High-level plan and asks: 

Summary of what Novafit needs:
- Quick validation of tokens / $ under our recommended serving options (hosted + prefetch cache + 8-token microbatches).
- Sensitivity table showing: baseline tokens/$, with prefix/KV cache hit rates at 0%, 40%, 80%; batching at sizes 1, 4, 16; 1- and 2- stage prefetch outcomes.
- Short qualitative notes on model fallback tradeoffs and cost-latency impact (they care about sub-500ms p95).

Proposed evaluation plan (deliverable by 2025-05-22 EOD):
- Lab bench: run three traffic sims based on Novafit's usage patterns (attached). Each sim will report: tokens generated, GPU seconds, observed throughput, p50/p95 latency, and effective tokens per $ (using our hosted unit costs + dedicated pricing scenarios).
- Prefetch test: warm KV cache with 10k common prompts then measure cold vs warm token counts and latency impact.
- Batching sweep: sizes [1,4,8,16] with concurrency tuned to match Novafit's reported QPS (see CSV).
- Deliverable: "map-cost-summary.xlsx" with a sensitivity sheet and a one-page MAP blurb for procurement.

Logistics / who does what:
- Karthik: run batching/prefetch bench on staging infra (INF-789 ticket). Please capture raw CSV outputs and a one-page summary.
- Marissa: draft the MAP addendum language and the tokens/$ sensitivity table for procurement (I started a sheet and will attach).
- David: sanity-check pricing math (dedicated vs hosted comps + recommended fallback policy).

Timeline:
- Wed 05/21: bench runs start (Karthik)
- Thu 05/22 by 17:00 PT: deliver map-cost-summary.xlsx + CSVs + one-pager
- Fri 05/23: internal review; Sat 05/24: send final to Novafit (Emily) so they can include in procurement packet

Attachments I will include: [prefetch-test-plan.md (MD), map-cost-summary.xlsx (sheet template)]

Emily — thanks for the clear asks. Karthik will post updates to JIRA INF-789 and I'll share the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bBenchFolder. If procurement wants an explicit per-conversation SLA/cost note, say so and we'll add a short clause for the MAP.

--
Olga Petrov
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com

Got it — I kicked off three bench runs this morning on staging (instances tagged: novafit-bench-05). Plan:

- Microbatch sweep: batch sizes 1,4,8,16 — each run is 30m with traffic profile from initial-usage-patterns.csv.
- Prefetch run: 10k warm prompts then a 1h mixed workload to measure decay.
- Metrics captured: tokens_in, tokens_out, GPU_seconds, p50/p95 latency, cache_hit_rate.

I'll upload raw CSVs to the Drive folder and drop a short summary CSV named batching-bench-results.csv. Expect deliverables (map-cost-summary.xlsx + CSVs) by EOD Thu 2025-05-22.

If procurement needs a formal DocuSign addition for pricing language, flag it here and I'll loop legal; otherwise we'll produce the MAP blurb and sensitivity table.

Thanks,
Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
